explanation: Binary-search how many of the first k merged elements come from the first array. A valid partition has both left boundary values no greater than the opposite right boundaries. Return the larger left boundary, which is the kth smallest value.
timeComplexity: O(log(min(m,k)+1)) time for the searched partition range.
